episodes.synopsis: As Percival turns sixteen, his grandfather tells him about the big world beyond their far-flung home — but the young man seems more interested in dinner.
episodes.title: THE BOY'S DEPARTURE

episodes.synopsis: On a journey to find his estranged father, Percival comes across a group of traveling performers who give him a lift to the nearest village.
episodes.title: THE UNKNOWN FORCE

episodes.synopsis: Although Percival puts up a good fight, the black knight hasn't unleashed his full powers yet. Suddenly, a mysterious red fox appears.
episodes.title: THE FOUR KNIGHTS OF THE APOCALYPSE

episodes.synopsis: Percival wakes up to find himself tied up and experimented on. His captor tells him that he's almost perfected the medicine he's been developing.
episodes.title: THE DEMON OF ECHO GORGE

episodes.synopsis: To return his grandfather to his original form, Nasiens will have to defeat another Holy Knight, and Percival is determined to help.
episodes.title: A RESOLVE FURTHER HONED

episodes.synopsis: Percival and his friends come across a fierce young woman named Anne who, against her father's will, dreams of becoming a Holy Knight.
episodes.title: SISTANA SHAKEN

episodes.synopsis: Although Ironside completely overpowers them, Percival, Anne and Nasiens put up a brave fight. But Donny is nowhere to be seen.
episodes.title: THE NAME OF THE MAGIC

episodes.synopsis: While Percival and crew struggle to destroy the Coffin of Eternal Darkness, a powerful mysterious ally faces the monsters raiding the town.
episodes.title: YOUNG HEROES

episodes.synopsis: The group — now joined by an exuberant Anne — make a stop in the rough town of Cant, where Donny has an awkward family reunion.
episodes.title: MASTER AND PUPIL

episodes.synopsis: While held captive, Howzer, Nasiens and the others find out that Edlin has stolen a dragon's egg, putting the whole town in danger.
episodes.title: ROAR OF DESTRUCTION

episodes.synopsis: As Percival, Donny and Anne have their hands full trying to stop the rampaging dragon, the still drunk Howzer asks Nasiens to sober him up.
episodes.title: A REAL HOLY KNIGHT

episodes.synopsis: On the way to Liones Kingdom, Sin experiences a peculiar dream. The next morning, despite a passerby's warning, the crew stumbles upon a strange village.
episodes.title: A SINISTER ENDEAVOR

episodes.synopsis: Percival faces off against Kellie, a powerful and merciless mythical beast. The crew chases Ardbeg into a mysterious cave, only to find out it's a trap.
episodes.title: THE CORNERED

episodes.synopsis: Ardbeg's magic transforms Percival and his crew into helpless babies. The elder of the demon clan village comes to their rescue, presenting an ultimatum.
episodes.title: THE GOAT SIN

episodes.synopsis: Arthur's men, hiding in the distance, ambush Gowther and Ardbeg. Restored to their original forms, Percival and his crew continue their perilous journey.
episodes.title: THE DARK TALISMANS

episodes.synopsis: Percival and his crew go head-to-head with the Dark Talismans. However, Fiddick devises a plan to defeat the young crew's source of strength.
episodes.title: DEPARTING FROM SIN

episodes.synopsis: Arriving at Liones Kingdom, Percival and his crew head to the castle to meet the king. But they find him absent, and soon Percival strays into trouble.
episodes.title: THE KING OF LIONES

episodes.synopsis: The former king has an ominous dream about the Four Knights. Percival and his crew are introduced to Tristan and set off in search of the fourth knight.
episodes.title: KIGHTS OF PROPHECY MEET

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious girl appears before Lancelot, delivering a prophecy. Meanwhile, a hostile drunkard provokes a fight with a Ruby Holy Knight.
episodes.title: LIONES IN FLAMES

episodes.synopsis: The Four Knights of Apocalypse finally gather together in one place. However, they can't agree on how to handle Pellegarde — until Percival steps in.
episodes.title: TAMING A WILD HORSE

episodes.synopsis: Under Arthur's orders, powerful members of the demon clan wreak havoc in the kingdom. Meliodas seeks to uncover the truth behind King Arthur's motives.
episodes.title: THE FOUR KNIGHTS VS THE SERVANTS OF CHAOS

episodes.synopsis: The Four Knights collaborate to combat the servants of Chaos. Meanwhile, sensing imminent danger, Lancelot makes his way to the castle.
episodes.title: FREEZING, BURNING HEARTS

episodes.synopsis: With Lancelot missing, Galland and Melascula resurrect by fusing together. Outmatched, Percival, Tristan and Gawain need all the help they can get.
episodes.title: ROYAL HOLY KNIGHTS VS MELA-GALLAND

episodes.synopsis: Drawing strength from the people's hope, Percival faces Mela-Galland, who proves to be too powerful. Tristan takes a dangerous risk to counterattack.
episodes.title: ADVENT
